editions.name: Late Edition
editions.description: The house default. Evening broadsheet — warm ink on near-black, one red mark per view.

editions.name: Newsprint
editions.description: Same paper, morning printing. Grain keeps it from reading as generic light mode.

editions.name: Sunday Supplement
editions.description: Slower, roomier, green ink. For people who write 3,000 words and want them to feel like a magazine feature.

editions.name: Clear Print
editions.description: Reading edition first. Hyperlegible type, no italics, bigger body, 7:1 contrast. Always available, never a premium unlock.

editions.name: Penny Dreadful
editions.description: Blackletter nameplate only; everything else is Garamond so it stays readable. Oxblood fills, candlelit ink.

editions.name: Pulp
editions.description: Yellowed stock, slab headlines, heavy rule under the tabs. Loud but still a column grid.
editions.fontsSummary: Alfa Slab One · Crimson Pro · Archivo Narrow

editions.name: Boudoir
editions.description: Plum paper, blush ink, italic Bodoni. Sensual without going pink-neon — it’s a letter, not a club flyer.

editions.name: Observatory
editions.description: Midnight blue and old gold. The dateline slug becomes the moon phase — a small, niche delight.

editions.name: Almanac
editions.description: Oat paper, moss ink, terracotta. Seasonal slug in the masthead. Soft, but still ruled and square.

editions.name: Archive
editions.description: Foxed sepia and letterpress Fell type. Metadata in small caps-ish Garamond instead of sans — a book, not an app.

editions.name: Photocopy

effects.texture: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px)

editions.description: Xerox grey, typewriter, one highlighter-pink fill. Black text on the pink button so it still reads.

editions.name: Terminal
editions.description: Phosphor green, amber actions, scanlines. The one theme allowed a glow — on the name only.

editions.name: Tabloid
editions.description: Red-top energy. Condensed caps, black rules, red kickers. Good for people whose whole page is a bit.

editions.name: Riso
editions.description: Two spot inks and a slight misregistration on headlines. Photo placeholders print blue-on-cream.

editions.name: Wire
editions.description: Teleprinter copy. No serifs, no italics, timestamps up front. The least decorated edition.

editions.name: Player One
editions.description: Pixel nameplate, clean techy body so posts stay readable. Lime is the one “press start” colour. Distinct from Terminal: modern console, not retro BBS.

editions.name: Sakura
editions.description: Blossom paper, plum ink, bubbly Japanese display that also sets kana. Episode-numbered masthead. Cute stays square — no rounded boxes, dotted rule instead.
editions.fontsSummary: Mochiy Pop One · M PLUS Rounded

editions.name: Varsity
editions.description: Navy and burnt orange, stadium condensed caps, a scoreboard-weight rule under the tabs. Stats row reads like a box score.

editions.name: Rulebook
editions.description: The box-insert manual: small caps headings, Alegreya body, teal like a player token. Masthead slug is the back-of-box player count.
editions.fontsSummary: Alegreya SC · Alegreya · Alegreya Sans SC

editions.name: Manuscript
editions.description: Almost nothing: white stock, Caslon, Spectral at a generous size, ink-blue as the only mark. Word count in the slug. The page gets out of the way of the prose.

editions.name: Quarterly
editions.description: Annual-report calm. Serif name, sans everything else, one corporate blue. For people who post under their real name and want it to look like it.

editions.name: Liner Notes
editions.description: Record-sleeve back: fat serif, tight Franklin, orange label. Listen posts become the lead block for these pages.

editions.name: Marquee
editions.description: Picture-palace deco on the nameplate, Baskerville for reviews, curtain red. Dark like the theatre before the trailers.

editions.name: Test Kitchen
editions.description: Butter paper, herb green, a chunky friendly nameplate. Recipe metadata replaces the edition slug.

editions.name: Field Notes
editions.description: Kraft-paper notebook with safety orange. Coordinates and weather in the slug; mono metadata like a logbook.
editions.fontsSummary: Zilla Slab · Source Serif 4 · Space Mono

editions.name: Leather
editions.description: Black, bone and violet; spaced caps, soft serif body. Frank without being lurid — suits the platform’s 21+ core audience.

editions.name: Arcana
editions.sampleMastheadLine: Card of the day · The Star, upright
editions.description: Aubergine, bone and brass. Decorative capitals on the nameplate only; the daily card replaces the edition slug. Warmer and more occult than Observatory.

editions.name: Deck Tape

effects.texture: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px)

editions.description: Grip-tape grain, heavy wide caps, one hi-vis yellow. Slug reads like a product drop.

editions.name: Con Badge
editions.description: Convention lanyard: signage-style nameplate, violet ink, badge number in the slug. Photo tab would lead for these profiles.

editions.name: Pride Print
editions.description: The flag appears once, as a hard-stop stripe rule under the tabs — printed, not glowing. Everything else stays calm; purple is the accent.

editions.name: Chapbook
editions.description: Small-press booklet: thin display caps, large Cormorant for verse, wine-red mark. Line breaks matter here, so body sets bigger than any other edition.

editions.name: Quiet Room
editions.description: Low-stimulation reading: sage paper, no caps shouting, no heavy rules. Pairs with an option to hide like/subscriber counts.

editions.name: Good Boy
editions.description: Warm biscuit paper, friendly rounded display, teal like a collar tag. The Photo tab would lead these pages.
